gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i7: tests that the hashcode is stable and suitable as a key
ADDED i1: Tag lookup ignores case: resolving a tag by a differently-cased name yields an equal (and, when looked up through the same TagSet, the identical) Tag instance.
ADDED i2: Run under the supplied locale to confirm case-folding is locale independent.
ADDED i3: Tag.valueOf builds against a fresh HTML TagSet, so lower- and upper-case lookups produce Tags that are equal but not necessarily the same instance.
ADDED i4: Looking up through one shared TagSet caches the Tag, so both casings return the exact same instance.
ADDED i5: A Tag's hashCode is derived only from its name and namespace, so it stays stable even after the Tag's options are mutated. This keeps a Tag usable as a HashSet
ADDED i6: Three distinct Tags: same name but different case, plus a same-name tag in another namespace. Each yields its own fixed hashCode.
ADDED i8: Mutating an option must not change the hashCode, or the key would be lost.
ADDED i9: All three are still found after the mutation.
